activity_baseline.feature_definition: account age; incoming record counts at <=t and in (t-91 days,t]
limitations: Counts inherit hosted snapshot foreign-key, deletion and survivorship assumptions.
No raw categorical, text, mutable snapshot or task-label features are included.
Schema/footer inspection cannot establish that exported values were available at the record timestamp.
Only constants and relative record time are approved; every candidate raw attribute remains excluded.
Historical foreign-key updates, entity merges, record deletions, and export survivorship have not been reconstructed.
Record-time visibility and per-query occurrence ownership must still pass the actual sampled-batch audit.
No preprocessing is fitted here. Any future learned preprocessing must be fitted on training-period data only.
This policy does not establish training readiness or predictive quality.

notes: Reference-only training preserves the existing encoder dropout.
GNN inputs are constants and relative record time; no raw attributes are enabled.
Normalizer statistics are literal constants, independent of validation data.
Official train/validation labels remain separate; the test split is untouched.
Each sampled occurrence uses its query timestamp in the exported snapshot graph.

Validation uses a fixed subset and sampling seed; this is not final task evaluation.
The short pilot measures supervised execution and cost, not a finished predictor.
Checkpoint resume requires matching inputs, code, configuration and runtime versions.

training.query_scheme: one fixed CPU-generator permutation, traversed circularly in query batches
training.seed_scheme: CPU/CUDA torch seed = base seed + zero-based optimizer step
training.timing_boundary: sampling + gathering + transfer + reference forward + BCE + backward + finite-gradient checks + optimizer step; excludes query scheduling, visibility/fingerprint audits, checkpoint writes, and reporting; step_ms is the sum of the two timed work regions
